document.querySelectorAll("img[data-picture]").forEach(el=>{el.src=worldImages[Number(el.dataset.picture)];}); let selectedWorld=0; function launch(i){selectedWorld=i;let p=gateways[i];document.body.classList.add('playing');document.getElementById('activeName').textContent=names[i];let g=document.getElementById('gateway');g.style.setProperty('--portal-a',p.a);g.style.setProperty('--portal-b',p.b);document.getElementById('gatewayWorld').textContent='✦ VÙNG ĐẤT '+String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')+' / 05 ✦';document.getElementById('gatewayTitle').textContent=p.title;document.getElementById('gatewayDesc').textContent=p.desc;document.getElementById('gatewayArt').innerHTML='<img class=\"gateway-picture\" alt=\"Minh họa vùng đất trò chơi\" src=\"'+worldImages[i]+'\">';document.getElementById('gatewayFeatures').innerHTML=p.features.map(x=>'<span>'+x+'</span>').join('');g.classList.add('on')} function beginGame(){const i=selectedWorld;document.getElementById('gateway').classList.remove('on');let frame=document.getElementById('frame');frame.onload=null;if(i===4){frame.srcdoc=sourceB;}else{frame.onload=()=>{try{const w=frame.contentWindow;const doc=w.document;doc.body.dataset.world=String(i);w.openGame(indexes[i]);const t=worldThemes[i];const badge=doc.getElementById('sceneBadge');const art=doc.getElementById('sceneEmoji');const chips=doc.getElementById('sceneChips');if(badge)badge.textContent='✦ '+t.badge+' ✦';if(art)art.innerHTML='<img class=\"scenePicture\" alt=\"Ảnh minh họa trò chơi\" src=\"'+worldImages[i]+'\">';if(chips)chips.innerHTML=gateways[i].features.map(x=>'<span>'+x+'</span>').join('');}catch(e){console.warn(e)}frame.onload=null;};frame.srcdoc=sourceGame;}} function exitGame(){const frame=document.getElementById('frame');frame.onload=null;frame.removeAttribute('srcdoc');frame.src='about:blank';document.getElementById('gateway').classList.remove('on');document.body.classList.remove('playing')} function goCare(){if(history.length>1)history.back();else location.assign('index.html')} document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&document.body.classList.contains('playing'))exitGame()}); </script></body></html>
